title: 第5章 火烧秦宫
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一场“分赃大会”如何撕裂天下？灭秦后，项羽为什么不称帝？项羽会如何分封？是优先封赏项氏子弟，还是重用异姓功臣？是杀刘邦以绝后患，还是遵约定封关中王？是定都彭城，还是迁都关中？

首先，单论项羽的分封开幕式就搞得十分红火，因为他真的放了一把大火。

项羽经过短暂的休整后，带领部队接管了咸阳。在咸阳，项羽主要干了这么几件事：屠咸阳、烧宫室、杀子婴、灭宗族，对秦朝的仇恨和敌对情绪激起了项羽内心深处破坏的恶念，他在咸阳大开杀戒，把复仇的锋芒指向了关中地区的无辜百姓，让他们来承受他滔天的怒火。

仇秦是项羽人生价值取向的重要内容之一，秦灭六国，楚人认为楚国最冤，楚怀王客死于秦，项燕在卫国战争中被杀，楚地一直流传着“楚虽三户，亡秦必楚”的口号。

作为楚国贵族的后代，国破家亡的强烈感受自然是刻骨铭心，所以，项羽从小就种下了对秦人不共戴天的仇恨，国仇家恨如同两道烙印深深铭刻在项羽心中，又如同两座大山压在项羽的肩上，这与当时席卷全国的反秦起义目标完全一致，因而成就了他早期的辉煌。

了解他的心态就能理解他入秦后的种种行为，他残暴对待的均是与秦朝有关的一切，他似乎要消除现实中所有与秦相关的一切信息和痕迹，似乎唯有如此，才能抚平他内心的伤痛。从刘邦的斧钺下好不容易捡回一条命的子婴终究也没能摆脱亡国之君的宿命。

子婴在除掉赵高的计划中展现了卓越的能力，如果早两年上台，说不定还能力挽狂澜，只可惜他生不逢时，只当了46天的国君，就做了秦朝的背锅侠，他躲过了刘邦的杀意，却没有躲过项羽的屠刀。

随着项羽一声令下，一颗颗人头落地，一场场大火冲天而起，照亮了黑压压的夜空，也照亮了关中百姓一张张苍白、惊恐、绝望的面容。数年的征战到了最后，竟不是天下人所期盼的太平，而是一场灾难。咸阳城的大火3月不灭，烟青云黑，遮天蔽日，所有美轮美奂、举国仰为神圣庄严的宫廷建筑都被付之一炬，化为灰烬。秦始皇仿照六国宫殿建造的庞大建筑群不复见于人类的眼帘，咸阳城内充满了黑暗、阴郁、肃杀之气。

提到火烧秦宫，有必要澄清一个流传千年的误传——项羽火烧阿房宫。这是唐代杜牧杜撰的，真正的阿房宫根本就没有建成。事情的真相是项羽并没有烧阿房宫，原因也很简单，阿房宫是个半拉子工程，连前殿都没有建成。

考古工作者在阿房宫前殿遗址20万平方米的勘探面内只发现了几处红烧土遗迹，未见大面积的红烧土、草木灰以及瓦当残片，而这本应该是建筑物遭到大火的焚烧后留下的遗迹。

鸿门宴后，项羽声威大震，那是他人生中最为风光的一段日子，在将首都咸阳烧杀抢掠一番、出了积压在自己胸中多年的对暴秦的怨气后，项羽有些仿徨和茫然，思之再三，他决定带着从咸阳搜取来的金银财宝和美貌女子东归。

作为土生土长的楚人，项羽对家乡有着非常浓厚的感情，他想念家乡的山山水水。此刻的项羽就像一个出门在外打拼多年的打工仔，在外面挣到钱了，只想回家盖房子娶媳妇。至于咸阳城，对项羽没有丝毫的吸引力。

回家前，项羽要完成一件大事，大秦帝国灭亡了，谁为天下之主？实行何种统治方式？这在当时确实是一件非常头疼的事，因为摆在项羽面前的有四个选项。

一是西周模式。这种模式就是“天子+诸侯”，选择一位天子作为天下共主，由他来分封诸侯。

How can a "spoils sharing conference" tear the world apart?After destroying Qin, why didn't Xiang Yu proclaim himself emperor?How will Xiang Yu divide the feudal lords?Should the descendants of the Xiang family be given priority, or should heroes with different surnames be given priority?Should he kill Liu Bang to avoid future troubles, or should he abide by the agreement and seal the king of Guanzhong?Should the capital be established in Pengcheng or moved to Guanzhong?

First of all, the opening ceremony of Xiang Yu's enfeoffment was very prosperous because he really set off a fire.

After a short rest, Xiang Yu led his troops to take over Xianyang.In Xianyang, Xiang Yu mainly did the following things: massacre Xianyang, burning palaces, killing children and infants, and annihilating clans. His hatred and hostility towards the Qin Dynasty aroused Xiang Yu's evil thoughts of destruction deep in his heart.

Chou against Qin is one of the important contents of Xiang Yu's life value orientation. Qin destroyed six kingdoms, and Chu people believed that Chu was the most unjust. King Huai of Chu died in Qin, and Xiang Yan was killed in the Great Patriotic War. The slogan "Although Chu has three households, Chu will surely destroy Qin" has been circulated in Chu land.

As a descendant of the aristocrats of the Chu Kingdom, the strong feeling of the destruction of the country and the death of the family is naturally unforgettable. Therefore, Xiang Yu has planted an irreconcilable hatred towards the Qin people since he was a child.

Understanding his mentality can understand his various behaviors after entering Qin. He treated everything related to the Qin Dynasty brutally. He seemed to want to eliminate all information and traces related to Qin in reality. It seemed that only in this way could he heal the pain in his heart.Ziying, who finally managed to save his life from Liu Bang's ax, could not escape the fate of being a subjugated king.

Ziying showed outstanding ability in the plan to get rid of Zhao Gao. If he had come to power two years earlier, he might have been able to turn the tide. Unfortunately, he was born at the wrong time. He only became the king for 46 days and became the scapegoat of the Qin Dynasty. He escaped Liu Bang's murderous intention, but did not escape Xiang Yu's butcher knife.

Following Xiang Yu's order, heads fell to the ground one after another, and fires shot up into the sky, lighting up the dark night sky and the pale, frightened, and desperate faces of the people in Guanzhong.After several years of fighting, at the end, it was not the peace that everyone in the world expected, but a disaster.The fire in Xianyang City lasted for March, with black smoke and black clouds, covering the sky and the sun. All the beautiful palace buildings that the whole country regarded as sacred and solemn were burned to the ground and reduced to ashes.The huge complex of buildings built by Qin Shihuang in imitation of the palaces of the Six Kingdoms is no longer visible to human eyes, and the city of Xianyang is filled with darkness, gloom, and a chilling atmosphere.

When it comes to burning the Qin Palace, it is necessary to clarify a misinformation that has been circulating for thousands of years - Xiang Yu burned the Epang Palace.This was made up by Du Mu in the Tang Dynasty, and the real Afang Palace was never built.The truth of the matter is that Xiang Yu did not burn Epang Palace. The reason is very simple. Epang Palace was a half-finished project, and even the front hall was not completed.

Archaeologists found only a few red-burnt earth relics in the 200,000-square-meter exploration area of ​​the Afang Palace front hall site. They did not find large areas of red-burnt earth, plant ashes, or tile fragments. These should have been the remains left after the building was burned by fire.

After the Hongmen Banquet, Xiang Yu became famous. It was the most glorious period in his life. After burning, killing and looting the capital Xianyang, and expressing the resentment against the violent Qin that had been stored in his chest for many years, Xiang Yu felt a little hesitant and confused. After thinking over and over again, he decided to return eastward with the gold and silver treasures and beautiful women he had collected from Xianyang.

As a native of Chu, Xiang Yu has very strong feelings for his hometown. He misses the mountains and rivers of his hometown.At this moment, Xiang Yu is like a wage earner who has worked hard for many years outside. After making money outside, he just wants to go home, build a house and marry a wife.As for Xianyang City, it has no attraction to Xiang Yu at all.

Before going home, Xiang Yu has to accomplish a major event. The Qin Empire has been destroyed. Who will be the master of the world?What kind of governance is practiced?This was indeed a headache at the time, because Xiang Yu had four options in front of him.

One is the Western Zhou Dynasty model.This model is "Emperor + Princes", choosing an emperor as the co-lord of the world, and he will divide the princes.
